0022600230.text: The Suns, 3-6 overall and 3-3 at home, host the 9th-ranked Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road) in Phoenix's 11th game of the season, with Phoenix sitting 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, after a loss in its last game. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams, who is out with a shoulder injury that required surgery, while Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams, and Kon Knueppel, who are out with hamstring injuries, and Brandon Miller and Moussa Diabate, who are day-to-day with groin soreness and a quadriceps issue, respectively, and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with Phoenix's most recent meeting a 127-107 loss in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
